integrity: Mathematical proof contains exponential-gap and mixed-redundancy classification. Reproducible numerical checks are corroborating, not an independent certification. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Only independent Poisson lines in exactly three equally spaced unoriented directions with arbitrary positive offset intensities, and only the cell containing the origin. No formula for conditioned area or other orientation distributions.
title: Complete vertex-count law for three-direction Poisson zero cells
